reviewer.conflict_declaration: The reviewer did not implement the runner or evidence corrections and performed a read-only review of the exact committed delta.

methods: Verified exact HEAD and a clean worktree before and after reviewing the new candidate report.
Ran the official validator, 19 negative fixtures, 13 source tests and syntax checks for the runner, validator and negative suite.
Independently mutated 57 candidate inputs, recomputing digests; all 57 invalid inputs were rejected.
Recomputed runner, dependency-lock, runtime-dist, all four case and report digests; all matched.
Verified source Git-state and source-snapshot before/after receipt equality; private input authenticity was not independently replayed.

resolved_findings.summary: The original runner accepted an arbitrary output path.
The original evidence did not record enough provenance or source mutation checks.
The original validator accepted self-attested fields without strict shape and effect-audit checks.
A version-prefix check allowed private path suffixes in the runtime Node version. Whole-string validation rejects all three reproduced bypasses.

verified_evidence: Four real-repository subsets remain observe_suggest with zero canonical writes, production effects or allowed technology drafts.
The original report and source worktree remained unchanged during the independent review.
All recorded before/after source state and snapshot digests match.
No raw private path or raw source content was found in the reviewed report.
The 57-case adversarial corpus includes prior output, claim-boundary, alias, path and runtime identity regressions.
unresolved_nonblocking_limits: Three private source trees were initially dirty but the recorded before/after state is unchanged.
Private source/config authenticity was not independently replayed from the public artifact.
The source immutability audit is application-level receipt consistency, not an external operating-system syscall trace.
Three cases retain 42, 39 and 50 conversion diagnostics; operational safety evidence does not imply extraction correctness.
This bounded adversarial corpus does not cover every possible validator input.
No external human peer review was performed.
attestation: An isolated AI-assisted reviewer verified the exact candidate, rejected all 57 adversarial mutations and reported zero unresolved Critical/High/Medium findings within this bounded pilot-only scope.
claim_boundary: This owner-authorized AI-assisted review supports the controlled observe/suggest pilot gate only. It is not external human peer review, production-write authorization, proof of extraction correctness or a release decision.
